title: Overpermissioned
banner: A scheduled cleanup job was captured during a lab review. Find the loose permissions.

/opt/cleanup/cleanup.conf.content:
# scheduled cleanup configuration
retention_days=14
archive_path=/var/lib/backup
rotate=true
notify=analysts@rabbit.lab

/opt/cleanup/rotate.sh.content:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate the service account credentials
openssl rand -base64 32 > /var/lib/backup/.svc.key
chmod 600 /var/lib/backup/.svc.key
